newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy unlikely to contract in 1997/98-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy unlikely to contract in 1997/98-EPA.

text.p: Japan's economy is unlikely to mark time or contract during the next fiscal year starting on April 1, Vice Economic Planning Agency Minister Shimpei Nukaya told a news conference on Friday.
Nukaya said it was difficult to envisage strong growth in the next fiscal year.
"If production recovers and income improves, the economy is expected to continue its slow recovery. I don't think the economy will mark time or contract in the next fiscal year," he said.
